verdict.rationale: Hummingbird is a commercial compliance and case-management SaaS. Whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions a public repository, published source, or an open-source license; even its developer docs are password-gated.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
